text_en: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority; and the earth was made bright with his splendor.
text_cn: 这些事以后，我看见另一位天使从天降下，掌有大权，下地被他的光荣照亮了。

text_en: He called out with a mighty voice, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! It has become a dwelling place of demons, a haunt of every foul spirit, a haunt of every foul bird, a haunt of every foul and hateful beast.
text_cn: 他用强大的声音喊说：“伟大的巴比伦陷落了！陷落了！她变成了邪魔的住所，一切不洁之神的牢狱，一切不洁和可憎飞禽的巢穴，【以及一切不洁和可憎走兽的圈槛，】

text_en: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich from the power of her luxury. ”
text_cn: 因为万民都喝了她荒淫的烈酒，地上的诸王都同她行过邪淫，地上的商人，也因她的放荡奢侈，而发了财。”

text_en: Then I heard another voice from heaven saying, “Come out of her, my people, so that you do not take part in her sins, and so that you do not share in her plagues;
text_cn: 我又听到了另一个声音从天上说：“我的百姓，你们从她中间出来罢！免得你们分沾她的罪恶，也免得遭受她的灾祸，

text_en: for her sins are heaped high as heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
text_cn: 因为她的罪恶已堆积得直达上天，使天主想起了她的不义。

text_en: Render to her as she herself has rendered, and repay her double for her deeds; mix a double draught for her in the cup she mixed.
text_cn: 她怎样虐待了人，你们也该怎样虐待她，并按照她所行的，要加倍报复她；她用什么杯斟给人，你们也要用什么杯加倍斟给她；

text_en: As she glorified herself and lived luxuriously, so give her a like measure of torment and grief. Since in her heart she says, ‘I rule as a queen; I am no widow, and I will never see grief, ’
text_cn: 她以前怎样自夸自耀，奢侈享乐，你们也就怎样加给她痛苦与哀伤：因为她心里说过：“我坐着当皇后，而不是寡妇，必见不到哀伤。”

text_en: therefore her plagues will come in a single day— pestilence and mourning and famine— and she will be burned with fire; for mighty is the Lord God who judges her. ”
text_cn: 为此，一日之内，她的灾祸：瘟疫、哀伤和饥荒全都来到；她要被火焚烧，因为惩治她的上主天主，是强而有力的。”

text_en: And the kings of the earth, who committed fornication and lived in luxury with her, will weep and wail over her when they see the smoke of her burning;
text_cn: 当时那些曾同她行过邪淫，和享过快乐的地上诸王，看到焚烧她的烟，都要为她流泪哀悼。

text_en: they will stand far off, in fear of her torment, and say, “Alas, alas, the great city, Babylon, the mighty city! For in one hour your judgment has come. ”
text_cn: 他们因害怕她受的痛苦，就远远站着说：“可怜，可怜！你这座伟大的城，这座强盛的巴比伦城！在一小时之内，你就受到了惩罚。”

text_en: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn for her, since no one buys their cargo anymore,
text_cn: 地上的商人也为她流泪哀伤，因为再没有人来买他们的货物：

text_en: cargo of gold, silver, jewels and pearls, fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet, all kinds of scented wood, all articles of ivory, all articles of costly wood, bronze, iron, and marble,
text_cn: 金银、宝石、珍珠、细麻布、紫红布、绸缎、朱红布等货物，以及各种香木、各种象牙器皿、各种贵重木器、铜、铁、大理石的器皿，

text_en: cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, choice flour and wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, slaves—and human lives.
text_cn: 还有肉桂、香膏、香料、香液、乳香、酒、油、面粉、麦子、牲口、羊群、骏马、车辆、奴隶与人口。

text_en: “The fruit for which your soul longed has gone from you, and all your dainties and your splendor are lost to you, never to be found again! ”
text_cn: 商人说：“你心中所爱吃的果品，都远离了你；一切肥美和华丽的物品，都在你前消逝了，再也寻不见了。”

text_en: The merchants of these wares, who gained wealth from her, will stand far off, in fear of her torment, weeping and mourning aloud,
text_cn: 贩卖这些货物，而由她发财的人，因害怕她受的痛苦，远远站着，流泪哀伤，

text_en: “Alas, alas, the great city, clothed in fine linen, in purple and scarlet, adorned with gold, with jewels, and with pearls!
text_cn: 说：“可怜，可怜！这伟大的城！这曾穿戴过细麻、紫红和朱红布衣裳，并以黄金、宝石和珍珠作装饰的城，

text_en: For in one hour all this wealth has been laid waste! ” And all shipmasters and seafarers, sailors and all whose trade is on the sea, stood far off
text_cn: 在一小时内，这样多的财富，就荡然无存了。”一切船长、一切到处航海的人、船员以及那些靠海谋生的人，都远远站着，

text_en: and cried out as they saw the smoke of her burning, “What city was like the great city? ”
text_cn: 看见焚烧她的烟，就呼喊说：“哪有一座城可与这座伟大的城相比呢！”

text_en: And they threw dust on their heads, as they wept and mourned, crying out, “Alas, alas, the great city, where all who had ships at sea grew rich by her wealth! For in one hour she has been laid waste. ”
text_cn: 他们在自己的头上撒灰，流泪哀伤，喊说：“可怜，可怜！这座伟大的城！凡在海中有船的人，都因她的富饶而发了大财。她怎么在一时之内就荡然无存了。”

text_en: Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints and apostles and prophets! For God has given judgment for you against her.
text_cn: 上天、圣徒、宗徒和先知们，你们因她的毁灭而欢腾罢！因为天主在她身上给你们伸了冤。

text_en: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, “With such violence Babylon the great city will be thrown down, and will be found no more;
text_cn: 然后，一位强而有力的天使，举起一块大如磨盘的石头，抛在海中说：“伟大的巴比伦城必要这样猛力地被人抛弃，再也找不着她了！

text_en: and the sound of harpists and minstrels and of flutists and trumpeters will be heard in you no more; and an artisan of any trade will be found in you no more; and the sound of the millstone will be heard in you no more;
text_cn: 弹琴者、歌唱者、吹笛者和吹号者的声音，在你中间再也听不到了；各种工艺的匠人，在你中间再也找不到了；推磨的响声，在你中间再也听不到了；

text_en: and the light of a lamp will shine in you no more; and the voice of bridegroom and bride will be heard in you no more; for your merchants were the magnates of the earth, and all nations were deceived by your sorcery.
text_cn: 灯台上的光，在你中间再也不发亮了；新郎与新娘的声音，在你中间再也听不到了，因为你的商人都是地上的要人，又因为万民都因你的邪术受了迷惑；

text_en: And in you was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slaughtered on earth. ”
text_cn: 且在此城中找到了诸先知、诸圣徒以及一切在地上被杀者的血。”
